_comment: How the pairs in config/prophecies.json were found and checked, 2026-11-01.

Found: docs/evidence/tools/prophecies/ reads every note of Matthew Henry (complete and Concise), John Calvin, John Wesley, the Geneva notes and the Church Fathers in the Catena Aurea, from the copies pinned in sources.json, and keeps each sentence that names a passage of the other Testament next to a word such as fulfilled, prophecy, foretold or predicted (603 sentences after joining each writer's sentences on one pair).

Checked: each sentence was read with both passages' BSB text and judged on its own words: kept only when the writer says the Old Testament passage foretold, or was fulfilled in, what the New Testament verse records. Left out: a passage only quoted, compared or applied; a prophecy fulfilled within Old Testament history; fulfil meaning obeying a law; the writer doubting the link; the fulfilment in another verse than the one given.

The New Testament's own statements (says in config/prophecies.json) were read from the BSB: each New Testament verse that says the passage was fulfilled, foretold or spoken of. Galatians 5:14 and James 2:8 (fulfilling the law) and Matthew 5:33 are not prophecies and are not listed.
records: every sentence kept, as config/prophecies.json cites it; left_out: every sentence not kept, with why. The build finds every kept quote word for word in its writer's note.

A second reading of every pair only writers name left out 33 pairs whose writer applies the words to a later event in passing (Proverbs 1:20 and Christ's preaching, Isaiah 45:1-2 and Peter's prison gate) rather than naming a prophecy and its fulfilment.
